title: 两面旗
blurb_en: She burns the grain meant for her husband's army to save his life, and cannot tell him why. He thinks she has chosen her family over him.
blurb_zh: 为了救丈夫的三万士兵，她亲手烧了送给他们的粮食，却不能告诉他为什么。
